blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.
blocks.zh: 结合了几种大语言模型(LLMS)的系统,常常会用一个上下文处理许多问题. 当上下文作为文本在模型之间传递时,接收模型会再次为每个问题处理其所有符号. 避免这一费用需要一种紧凑、跨问题可重复使用、可由不同LLM读取的上下文表述。 现有的压缩和潜在通信方法只提供其中一些特性。 我们引入了LatComm,即Latett通信接口,它通过将编码与读取区分来提供所有三个:上下文被编码一次,没有问题,接收者选择每个问题要读什么. 一个被冻结的上下文编码器LLM将上下文压缩成一个固定大小的包并发送给另一个被冻结的接收器LLM,它通过交叉注意读取了包,门从它的快取来计算. 在12个多选择问答数据集上,LatComm比单向量基线提高平均精度,最高可达10.2分. 在"Quality"上,它将接收器的输入减少57x并更快地回答第3x条的问题.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Motivation. Communication between large language models (LLMs) enables models to contribute different roles to a shared task, such as processing documents and answering questions ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . In context-dependent workflows ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Yao et al., 2023 ) , the same context is often used many times: one document can support many questions, and one observation can inform later decisions. When the context is passed as text, the model that receives it, called the receiver , processes all of its tokens again for every question (Figure 1 a). Shared contexts therefore lead to repeated computation across models and questions ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024a ) .
For example, in the reading comprehension dataset QuALITY ( Pang et al., 2022 ) , each article comes with 18.1 questions on average. The receiver reads 5,915 tokens for each question, and 98% of them are the article (Figure 1 d).
blocks.zh:
动静. 大语言模型(LLMs)之间的交流使得模型能够为共同的任务贡献不同的作用,如处理文件和回答问题(Wu等人,2023年;Hong等人,2024年;Du等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年;Lin等人,2026年). 在依赖上下文的工作流程中(Lewis et al., 2020; Yao et al., 2023),同样的上下文经常被多次使用:一个文件可以支持许多问题,一个观察可以为后来的决定提供参考. 当上下文作为文本被传递时,接收它的模型,称为接收器 ,再次处理每个问题的所有符号(图1 a). 因此,共同的背景导致跨模型和问题重复计算(Gim等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年b;Liu等人,2024年a).
例如,在读取理解数据集QuALITY(Pang等人,2022年)中,每篇文章平均有18.1个问题。 接收器每个问题读取5,915个令牌,其中98%是文章(图1d).

blocks.en: Latent passing. Latent passing avoids this repetition (Figure 1 b). An encoder reads the context once and turns it into vectors, called latents . The latents are stored and reused, so the receiver reads only the question. To replace the text, the latents need three properties. They must be reusable : they are computed once, before any question is known. They must be compact : their size does not grow with the context length, so the cost of storing and reading them stays fixed. They must be readable by a different LLM , because systems often combine models of different sizes ( Li et al., 2025 ; Belcak et al., 2025 ) and from different families ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . These properties are hard to combine. Latents built without the question and with a fixed size cannot keep only what one question needs, so the receiver must select the relevant information when it reads.
blocks.zh: 迟钝的经过。 后传可以避免这种重复(图1b). 一个编码器读过上下文一次,然后变成矢量,称为潜伏. 潜伏物被存储和再利用,所以接收器只读问题. 为了取代文本,潜伏者需要三个属性. 它们必须可以重复使用:在知道任何问题之前计算一次。 它们必须是紧凑的:它们的大小不会随着上下文长度的增加而增加,因此储存和阅读它们的成本保持不变。 它们必须由不同的LLM读取,因为系统经常结合不同大小的模型(Li等人,2025年;Belcak等人,2025年)和不同家庭的模型(Chen等人,2024年;Ong等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年)。 这些属性很难结合. 没有问题和固定大小的Lateents不能只保留一个问题需要的东西,所以接收器在读取时必须选择相关信息.

blocks.en: Existing approaches. Existing methods provide only some of these properties. A receiver can store its key–value cache to avoid re-reading ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) , but this cache grows with the context length and can be used only by the model that produced it. Context compression methods shorten what a model reads ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Mu et al., 2023 ; Chevalier et al., 2023 ) . ICAE compresses a context into fixed memory slots without the question, but it adapts the LLM with LoRA, and the slots are read by the same LLM ( Ge et al., 2024 ) . xRAG keeps both models frozen and stores one vector per document ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) . This vector is the output of a pretrained retrieval encoder, so the amount of context that it carries is fixed by that encoder. A larger representation would need a larger projector, and its trainable parameters would grow with the size of the representation. Latent communication methods pass representations between models in place of text ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Yang and Eshraghian, 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . C2C transfers representations between different frozen LLMs, but both models read the same input, so the transfer depends on the question and grows with the input length ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 compares representative methods on four properties, and only LatComm has all four.
blocks.zh: 现有办法。 现有方法只提供其中一些属性。 接收器可以存储其密钥–值缓存以避免重读(Gim等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年b),但这种缓存随着上下文长度的增大而增长,只能被生成它的模型使用. 上下文压缩方法缩短模型的内容(Pan等人,2024年;Mu等人,2023年;Chevalier等人,2023年)。 ICAE将一个上下文压缩成没有问题的固定内存槽,但会和LORA一起适应LLM,槽由相同的LLM读取(Ge等人,2024年). xRAG将两种型号均保持冷冻,每份文件存储一个矢量(Cheng等人,2024年)。 这个矢量是预加训练的检索编码器的输出,所以它携带的上下文量是由该编码器固定的. 更大的代表性需要更大的投影仪,其可训练参数随着代表性的大小而增加。 Latent通信方法通过模型之间的表达来代替文本(Ramesh和Li,2025年;Du等人,2026年;Yang和Eshraghian,2025年;Shi等人,2026年)。 C2C在不同的冷冻LLMs之间转移表示,但两种模型都读取相同的输入,因此转移取决于问题,并随输入长度而增长(Fu等人,2026年). 表1比较了四个属性的代表性方法,只有LatComm拥有全部四个属性.

blocks.en: Approach and results. We introduce LatComm , a latent communication interface that separates encoding from reading (Figure 2 ). In the encoding step, a frozen context encoder LLM reads the context without the question, and learned context compressors map its token states into a fixed number of low-dimensional slots. These slots form a compressed packet , which is computed once, stored, and sent to the receiver for every question. Because the compressors read all token states of the encoder through cross-attention, a larger packet needs only more slot queries rather than a larger projector. In the reading step, a frozen receiver LLM reads the packet through cross-attention, and gates computed from its prompt control the contribution of each slot, so that different questions can use different parts of the same packet. Both LLMs stay frozen throughout, and only the compressors, readers, and gates are trained. The interface can therefore connect the same model, models of different sizes, or models from different families. On 12 question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver’s input by 57 × 57\times and answers all questions of an article 3 × 3\times faster (Figure 1 c, d).
blocks.zh: 方法与结果。 我们引入了LatComm ,一个将编码和读取区分开来的潜在通信接口(图2). 在编码步骤中,一个冷冻的上下文编码器LLM在没有问题的情况下读取上下文,并且学习到的上下文压缩器将它的符号状态映射成一个固定的数个低维槽. 这些插槽构成一个压缩包,每题计算一次,存储一次,并发送到接收器. 由于压缩机通过交叉注意读取编码器的所有符号状态,一个更大的数据包只需要更多的位查询而不是更大的投影仪. 在读取步骤中,一个被冷冻的接收器LLM通过交叉注意读取包,门从它的迅速控制中计算出每个槽的贡献,这样不同的问题就可以使用同一个包的不同部分. 两种LLMS在全程保持冷冻状态,只有压缩机,阅读器,闸门都经过训练. 因此界面可以连接同一个模型,大小不同的模型,或来自不同家庭的模型. 在12个问答数据集上,LatComm比单向量基线提高平均精度,最高可达10.2分. 在QuALITY上,它将接收器的输入减少57×57\时,并更快地回答第3×3\时的所有问题(图1c,d).

blocks.en: Contributions. Our contributions are as follows: • We formulate context communication between LLMs as two steps, encoding without the question and reading with the question, with a packet of fixed size between them. • We introduce LatComm , an interface between two frozen LLMs with context compressors, cross-attention readers, and per-layer, per-slot gates. It is trained in two stages, so that packets stored after the first stage remain valid. • We show that LatComm is more accurate than single-vector baselines, answers questions three times faster than text passing, and connects six LLM pairs of different sizes and families. • We release a PyTorch implementation with training and evaluation configurations. 1 1 1 https://github.com/huawei-lin/LatComm
blocks.zh: 捐款。 • 我们的贡献如下: 我们把LLMs之间的上下文通信作为两个步骤,即不提问编码和与问题一起阅读,它们之间有一个固定大小的包。 我们引入了LatComm,这是两个冷冻的LLMS与上下文压缩机,交叉阅读器,以及每层每层门的接口. • 分为两个阶段进行训练,以便第一阶段后储存的包件仍然有效。 我们显示,LatComm比单向量基线更准确,回答问题的速度比文本传递快3倍,并且连接了6对不同大小和家庭的LLM对. ^ 我们发布了一个PyTorch执行方案,并附有培训和评价配置。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Context compression. Context compression reduces the input that an LLM reads. LLMLingua-2 keeps a subset of the tokens ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , so its output is still text. Gist tokens, AutoCompressor, and ICAE train an LLM to encode a prompt or a context into a few vectors that the same LLM reads ( Mu et al., 2023 ; Chevalier et al., 2023 ; Ge et al., 2024 ) . xRAG maps one retrieval embedding per document into a frozen LLM ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) . CEPE and Flamingo feed a separately encoded input to a frozen language model through inserted cross-attention layers ( Yen et al., 2024 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ) . CEPE trains a small encoder for its decoder and keeps one vector per context token, and the gates of Flamingo are learned constants. LatComm compresses the hidden states of one LLM into a fixed number of slots, which a different LLM reads through gates that change with its prompt.
blocks.zh: 上下文压缩. 上下文压缩会减少 LLM 读取的输入. LLMLingua-2保留了符号的子集(Pan et al., 2024),因此其输出仍然是文本. Gist aircords, AutoCompressor, and ICAE 训练LLM,将一个提示或一个上下文编码成几个与LLM相同的矢量(Mu等人,2023年;Chevalier等人,2023年;Ge等人,2024年). xRAG将每个文档一个检索嵌入一个冷冻LLM(Cheng等人,2024年). CEPE和Flamingo通过插入的交叉注意层向冷冻语言模型提供单独编码的输入(Yen等人,2024年;Alayrac等人,2022年)。 CEPE为它的解码器训练一个小编码器,并保持每个上下文符号一个矢量,火烈鸟的门是学习常数. LatComm将一个LLM的隐藏状态压缩成一个固定的槽数,一个不同的LLM读取的闸门随其及时变化.

blocks.en: Latent communication. Latent communication passes internal representations between models in place of text, such as activations, hidden states, translated vectors, or selected key–value (KV) pairs ( Ramesh and Li, 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Yang and Eshraghian, 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . DroidSpeak reuses KV caches across LLMs with the same architecture ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , and LatentMAS passes the KV caches of one agent to the next without training ( Zou et al., 2025 ) . C2C trains cache fusers between different frozen LLMs ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . It transfers per-token states of an input that the two models both read, so the transfer grows with the input length. LatComm instead sends a packet with several slots per layer that is built without the question, and each receiver token reads it through gates computed from the prompt.
blocks.zh: 后传. Latent通信在代替文本的模型之间传递内部表达,如激活,隐藏状态,翻译矢量,或选定的键值(KV)对(Ramesh和Li,2025;Du等人,2026;Yang和Eshraghian,2025;Shi等人,2026). DroidSpeak重复使用具有相同架构的 LLMS 的 KV 缓存(Liu 等人, 2024a), MAS将一个特工的KV缓存传递给下一个特工,没有经过训练(Zou等人,2025年). C2C型列车在不同的冷冻LLMs之间执行缓存引信(Fu等人,2026年). 它会传送一个输入状态,两个模型都读过,因此,转移随着输入长度的增加而增加. LatComm 转而发送一个包,每层有数个插槽,这些插槽是在没有问题的情况下建造的,每个接收符都通过从提示计算出来的门读取.

blocks.en: Consider a context x x , such as a document, and a prompt r r that contains a question about x x , the task instructions, and any answer choices. With text passing, the receiver LLM reads x x followed by r r and generates the answer y y , so it processes x x again for every prompt (Figure 1 a). With LatComm , the receiver reads only r r (Figure 1 b). A second LLM, the context encoder LLM , reads x x once and sends a compressed packet 𝒵 ⁡ ( x ) \mathcal{Z}(x) , a fixed number of learned vectors, and the receiver generates y y from r r and 𝒵 ⁡ ( x ) \mathcal{Z}(x) . The packet is the receiver’s only source of context information, and both LLMs stay frozen.

blocks.en: The packet passes between selected layers of the two models (Figure 2 a). At each of these layer pairs, a compressor turns the encoder’s token states, the hidden states that the layer computes for each token, into a few slots. A reader with gates then adds the information that the current prompt needs to the receiver’s states (Figure 2 b). Only the compressors, readers, and gates are trained, in two stages.

Context reconstruction. Stage 1 trains all of θ \theta . The receiver gets an instruction to reproduce the context, and the target is the context itself, tokenized by the receiver and followed by an end-of-sequence token. blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: The experiments address three research questions. RQ1: Can a context be encoded once, without the question, and reused for different questions? RQ2: How much useful information does a packet keep under a fixed size budget? RQ3: Can two different LLMs communicate through the packet, across model sizes and model families?

blocks.en: Table 3 compares all methods with the Qwen3.5-0.8B receiver on the 12 task datasets and on the three held-out datasets. LatComm is the best compressed-context method on both averages. On the task datasets, it reaches 65.43 Task Avg, against 61.98 for the best baseline, and it has the highest accuracy among the compressed-context methods on 11 of the 12 datasets. On the held-out datasets, which are not used in training, it reaches 49.76 Held-out Avg, against 46.70 for the best baseline, and it has the highest accuracy on all three datasets. LatComm is also above the Constant packet by 5.2 points on Task Avg and by 6.4 points on Held-out Avg. The Constant packet uses the same trained readers and gates but carries no context information, so this gain shows that the packet gives the receiver useful information about the context.
blocks.zh: 表3比较了12个任务数据集和三个搁置数据集上的所有方法与Quen3.5-0.8B接收器. LatComm是两个平均值上最好的压缩-折叠法. 在任务数据集上,它达到65.43 Task Avg,而最佳基线为61.98,在12个数据集中的11个数据集的压缩折叠法中,它的准确度最高. 在未用于培训的被搁置数据集上,它达到了49.76 Hold-out Avg,而最佳基线为46.70,在所有三个数据集中它的准确度最高。 LatComm在Avg任务上也比Constant包高5.2分,在Hold-out Avg任务上则高6.4分. 常量包使用相同的训练有素的读取器和闸门,但没有包含上下文信息,因此这一增益显示数据包给接收器提供了上下文的有用信息.

blocks.en: Raw-text is not trained on the task data. Every trained method is above Raw-text on the task datasets and below it on the held-out datasets (41.72–49.76 against 65.06 Held-out Avg), and this includes the Constant packet. The modules trained on the 12 task datasets therefore transfer only in part to new datasets. This holds for every trained method, and LatComm is the most accurate.
blocks.zh: 原始文本没有接受任务数据培训。 在任务数据集上,每种训练有素的方法都高于Raw-text,在被搁置数据集上,低于Raw-text(41.72-49.76对65.06 Hold-out Avg),这包括常数包。 因此,12个任务数据集培训的模块只部分转移到新的数据集。 这对每一种训练有素的方法来说都是如此,而LatComm是最准确的.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Family Receiver
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨家庭接收者

blocks.en: Table 5 repeats the comparison with a receiver from another model family, Gemma-3-1B-pt, and with the Qwen3.5-9B context encoder. Without training, this receiver is close to chance level with or without the context (27.73 and 27.98 Task Avg). LatComm reaches 59.00 Task Avg, against 55.46 for the best baseline and 54.04 for the Constant packet. On the held-out datasets, LatComm reaches 46.63 Held-out Avg, against 40.59 for the best baseline and 41.30 for the Constant packet. It has the highest accuracy among the compressed-context methods on 10 of the 12 task datasets and on all three held-out datasets. The interface therefore also works when the context encoder and the receiver come from different model families.
blocks.zh: 表5重复了与另一个型号家族Gemma-3-1B-pt的接收器的比较,并与Quen3.5-9B上下文编码器的比较. 不经过培训,该接收器与上下文(27.73和27.98 Task Avg)接近机会水平。 LatComm达到59.00 Task Avg,最佳基线为55.46,常数包为54.04。 在搁置数据集上,LatComm达到46.63 Hold-out Avg,最佳基线为40.59,常数包为41.30。 在12个任务数据集中的10个数据集和所有3个搁置数据集的压缩文本方法中,它的准确度最高。 因此,当上下文编码器和接收器来自不同的模型家族时,界面也起作用.

blocks.en: The two Embedding baselines are below the Constant packet on Held-out Avg. This difference comes from QuAIL. Every QuAIL question has a “not enough information” option, which is correct for 306 of the 2,720 questions. The Embedding baselines choose it for 18.5% and 25.0% of the questions, against 7.4% for the Constant packet and 7.5% for LatComm . On RACE and DREAM, the Embedding baselines are within 2.3 points of the Constant packet.

blocks.en: For RQ3, Table 6 compares LatComm with two trained references for six pairs of LLMs. In every pair, the receiver does not read the context, so its context information comes only from the packet that the context encoder LLM sends. With the Qwen3.5-0.8B receiver, Task Avg is 64.91 when the same model is the context encoder, 65.43 with the 4B encoder, and 65.80 with the 9B encoder. The three encoders are within 0.9 points of each other, so the interface works with a small encoder, and one model can serve as both encoder and receiver. Across model families, the Gemma-3-1B-pt receiver reaches 59.00–59.21 with Qwen3.5 encoders, and the Llama-3.2-1B receiver reaches 64.08 with the Granite-4.1-8B encoder. In all six pairs, LatComm is 3.5 to 5.6 points above the Constant packet and 2.7 to 3.8 points above the Embedding baseline, both trained with the same receiver. The packet thus passes context information between LLMs of different sizes and families.

blocks.en: For RQ1, one packet serves every question about its context. In the test set, one context has 18.1 questions on average in QuALITY, 14.2 in CLOTH, and 5.7 in MCScript2.0. Table 7 reports the measured cost on QuALITY. Encoding an article once takes 0.71 s. The receiver then answers a question in 131 ms with the packet, against 511 ms from the full text (Figure 1 d). A Query-only pass takes 111 ms, so the readers and gates add only 20 ms per question. For one article with 18.1 questions, the packet path takes 3.09 s in total and the text path takes 9.26 s, so the packet path is 3.0 times faster (Figure 1 c). Encoding once costs less from the second question.
blocks.zh: 对于RQ1,一个包服务于每一个有关其上下文的问题. 在测试集中,一个上下文平均有18.1个问题在QuALITY,14.2个CLOTH,5.7个MCScript2.0. 表7报告了计量的Quality成本。 一篇文章编码一次需要0.71 s. 接收器然后用数据包在131毫秒内回答一个问题,与全文的511毫秒对齐(图1d). 只有查询的通行证需要111毫秒,所以读者和大门每题只加20毫秒. 对于一篇有18.1题的文章,包路径总共需要3.09 s,文本路径则需要9.26 s,因此包路径更快3.0倍(图1 c). 编码从第二个问题开始成本降低。

blocks.en: The gain grows with the context length (Figure 7 ). With text passing, the time per question grows from 300 ms for the fifth of the questions with the shortest articles to 651 ms for the fifth with the longest. With a packet it stays near 131 ms, so the receiver is 2.3 to 4.9 times faster. Figure 4 a compares the settings of LatComm with Raw-text and Query-only. Every setting takes between 121 and 133 ms per question. The slot count does not change the time, and with 6 layer pairs the readers and gates add 6.2 ms instead of 20.5 ms. Encoding takes 0.54 to 0.73 s with the three encoders (Figure 4 b).

blocks.en: For RQ2, the default packet takes 384 KiB per context. Task Avg stays between 65.0 and 65.8 when the slot count changes from 8 to 64, so a 96 KiB packet with 8 slots per pair keeps the accuracy of the default packet. A slot width of 512 raises Task Avg to 66.88. Every packet configuration is above the best single-vector baseline (61.98). Appendix D reports all configurations.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LatComm , a latent communication interface between frozen LLMs. A context encoder LLM compresses a context once into a fixed-size packet, and a receiver LLM, which can differ from the encoder in size and family, reads it for every question through cross-attention with gates computed from its prompt. LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points, and on QuALITY it answers the questions of an article 3 × 3\times faster than text passing. Future work will study packets as messages in multi-agent systems and as entries in agent memory.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LatComm, 冷冻LLMs之间的潜在通信接口。 一个上下文编码器LLM一次将上下文压缩成一个固定大小的包,一个接收器LLM,在大小和家族上可能与编码器不同,通过交叉注意来读取每个问题的每个问题,门从它的提示计算出来. LatComm将单向基线的平均准确度提高了10.2点,在QuALITY上,它比文本的通过更快地回答了第3×3\时间的问题。 今后的工作将研究作为多代理系统中的信息和代理内存条目的包。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments cover multiple-choice question answering in English, where the answer is a single option letter. We do not evaluate free-form generation, and we do not test the multi-agent and agent-memory uses that motivate reusable packets. The receivers have about one billion parameters and the encoders have at most nine billion, so the behavior of the interface with larger receivers is not known. In addition, only Stage 2 of the default pair is repeated with three seeds, which gives a standard deviation of 0.23 points in Task Avg. Every other configuration uses one seed, so small differences between the configurations of the ablation study should be read with care.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验包括用英语回答的多选择问题,其中的答案是单个选项字母. 我们不评估自由形式的生成,也不测试刺激可重复使用的包的多剂和剂-模组用途。 接收器有大约10亿个参数,编码器最多有90亿个参数,因此界面与较大接收器的行为并不为人所知. 此外,只有默认配对的阶段2与3个种子重复,这在Task Avg中给出了0.23分的标准偏差. 每个其它的配置都使用一个种子,因此应该谨慎地阅读衰竭研究的配置之间的小差异.

blocks.en: LatComm is trained for one pair of models, so a new context encoder or receiver needs its own compressors, readers, and gates, and its own packets. The interface also reads and writes hidden states, and therefore it does not apply to models that are available only through a text interface. Finally, because the packet has a fixed size, a longer context is compressed more strongly. Stage 1 uses passages of at most 1,024 tokens, and the longest contexts in our evaluation are the QuALITY articles. We do not study how the packet size should grow with the context length.
blocks.zh: LatComm为一对型号训练,所以一个新的上下文编码器或接收器需要自己的压缩机,读取器,和门,以及自己的包. 界面还读写隐藏状态,因此不适用于仅通过文本界面提供的模型. 最后,由于包的大小固定,较长的上下文压缩得更强烈. 第一阶段使用最多1 024个符号的段落,我们评价中最长的背景是QuALITY的文章。 我们不研究包大小应如何随着上下文长度而增长。

blocks.en: Supervision and payload. Reconstruction targets include the end-of-sequence token. Equation 4 averages over supervised response tokens, rather than giving equal weight to responses of different lengths. The context encoder LLM is evaluated without gradients. In Stage 1, gradients through the frozen receiver update the compressors, readers, and gates. In Stage 2, they update only the readers and gates. If a stored scalar occupies w w bytes, the packet’s payload is w ​ d ​ ∑ i S i wd\sum_{i}S_{i} bytes, excluding metadata. Gate and reader parameters are stored at the receiver rather than transmitted in the packet.

blocks.en: Training protocol implementation. Stage 2 loads the complete Stage 1 interface, including the prompt-pooling and gate parameters, from the final Stage 1 checkpoint with strict key matching, and starts a new optimizer and learning-rate schedule. The model pair, layer pairing, slot count, and latent width are identical in both stages, so every interface tensor transfers without reshaping or reinitialization. The compressor parameters are then frozen. Packets for the training contexts are computed once with the frozen encoder and compressors; identical contexts share one stored packet. The packets are stored in bfloat16. Stage 2 training reads the packets and does not load the context encoder LLM.
blocks.zh: 培训协议的执行。 第2阶段从最后第1阶段检查站装入完整的第1阶段接口,包括快速集合和闸门参数,严格按键匹配,并开始一个新的优化器和学习率时间表。 模型对对,层对,槽计数,以及潜在宽度在两个阶段都是相同的,所以每个接口的百合调值都不需重塑或重新初始化. 压缩机参数随后被冻结. 培训背景的包与冷冻编码器和压缩器一起计算一次;相同的背景共享一个存储的包。 这些包被储存在bfloat16中. 第2阶段训练读取包,不装入上下文编码器LLM.

blocks.en: Table 8: Data for both training stages and the held-out datasets. Train excludes the development holdout. Tokens count untruncated context text once per training example with the pinned Qwen3.5-0.8B tokenizer, excluding instructions, choices, targets, and special tokens. Reconstruction supervision contains the same text plus one EOS per passage (1,135,752,208 target tokens). Avg. context is the mean training context length in tokens, rounded to one decimal; total-row means are weighted by example count. For the held-out datasets, it is the mean context length of the test questions. Eval is the reconstruction test set, the fixed public multiple-choice reporting suite, or the held-out test set.
blocks.zh: 表8:培训阶段和搁置数据集的数据。 火车排除了发展阻力。 托肯斯用标注的 Quen3.5-0.8B 标注符计算每个训练例一次未刷卡的上下文文本,不包括指令,选择,目标,以及特殊符号. 重建监督包含相同的文字加上每段1,135,752,208个目标符号的EOS. Avg.上下文是符号中的平均训练上下文长度,四舍五入到小数点后;总行表示值按例数加权. 对于被搁置的数据集,它是测试问题的平均上下文长度. Eval是重建测试集,固定的公共多选择报告套件,或搁置测试集.

blocks.en: Training settings. Table 9 lists the training hyperparameters. Stage 1 runs one epoch over the reconstruction passages. Stage 2 then fixes the compressors, stores one packet for each training context, and runs three epochs over the task training set. The readers and gates that it trains have 16.4M parameters for the Qwen3.5-0.8B receiver. Both stages use AdamW with the default momentum coefficients. In Stage 1, the learning rate rises linearly for 157 updates and then stays constant. In Stage 2, it rises linearly for 45 updates and then follows a half-cosine decay to zero. The trained baselines use the same task data, loss, batch size, number of epochs, and learning-rate schedule. Every run uses random seed 42, and Stage 2 of the default pair is repeated with seeds 43 and 44.
blocks.zh: 培训环境。 表9列出了训练超参数。 第一阶段在重建通道上划了一个时代。 第二阶段然后修复压缩机,为每个培训环境存储一个包,并在任务培训包上运行三个时代。 它所训练的阅读器和门有16.4M参数的Quen3.5-0.8B接收器. 两个阶段都使用带有默认动力系数的亚当W. 在第一阶段,157项更新的学习率呈线性上升,然后保持不变。 在阶段2中,它为45个更新线性上升,然后跟随半倍径衰变为零. 经培训的基线使用相同的任务数据、损失、批量大小、时代数目和学习率时间表。 每跑一次使用随机种子42,默认对的阶段2则与种子43和44重复.

blocks.en: Environment. LatComm runs use Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.11 or 2.13, and Hugging Face Transformers 5.15.1. The frozen models and the interface modules run in 16-bit bfloat16, and packets are stored in the same format. All experiments run on six machines, each with eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs (80 GB each). The trained interfaces are evaluated with Transformers. The Raw-text reference on the 12 task datasets is computed with vLLM.
blocks.zh: 环境。 LatComm运行时使用Python 3.12,PyTorch 2.11或2.13,以及Hugging Face Transformers 5.15.1. 冷冻模型和以16位bfloat16运行的界面模块,以及包以相同格式存储. 所有实验都运行在六台机器上,每台都有8台NVIDIA H100 GPU(每台80GB). 训练有素的界面用变形金刚来评价. 12个任务数据集的原始文本参考用vLLM计算。

blocks.en: Reconstruction data. The Stage 1 training set contains 2,000,000 passages: 446,282 from WikiText-103 and 1,553,718 from FineWeb-Edu. They are a fixed selection of complete passages from the prepared corpus. Each passage contains 64–1,024 tokens under the Qwen3.5-0.8B tokenizer. The receiver is asked to reproduce the passage with one of 100 reconstruction instructions. Validation and test contain 15,043 and 14,983 passages. WikiText-103 keeps its official splits, and FineWeb-Edu is split by canonical URL before passage extraction. English filtering, passage deduplication, and document-level separation are applied.

blocks.en: Task data. Table 8 lists the 12 task datasets. After removing exact normalized context overlaps with the test set and invalid duplicate answer texts, the official training pool contains 284,477 questions. A grouped holdout from this pool gives 2,036 development questions, and the remaining 282,441 questions are used for training. The test set contains 55,890 labeled questions from public benchmark splits. These questions are not used for training or model selection. The original option text, option count, and option order are kept. SciQ uses a fixed deterministic option order because its source does not specify one. MuTual uses its labeled development split for testing because its official test labels are not public. We also compute Micro, the accuracy over all 55,890 test questions.
blocks.zh: 任务数据. 表8列出了12个任务数据集。 在移除了精确的规范化上下文与测试集重叠和无效的重复解答文本后,官方训练集合包含284,477个问题. 从这一人才库中分批抽出2 036个发展问题,其余282 441个问题用于培训。 测试集包含55,890个标注来自公共基准分割的问题. 这些问题不用于培训或模式选择。 保留原有的选项文本、选项数和选项顺序。 SciQ使用固定的确定选项顺序,因为其来源没有指定一个. MuTual因其官方的测试标签不公开而使用其标签化的开发分裂进行测试. 我们还计算Micro, 所有55,890个测试问题的准确性。

blocks.en: Held-out datasets. RACE, DREAM, and QuAIL are used only for testing. RACE and DREAM use their official test sets. QuAIL uses its validation and challenge sets. No held-out passage is an exact match of a Stage 2 training context. Some RACE passages share text with CLOTH training passages, and some DREAM dialogues share text with MuTual training dialogues, because these datasets draw on similar exam material. Removing the affected questions (294 in RACE and 349 in DREAM) changes the accuracy of every method by less than one point.
blocks.zh: 被搁置的数据集。 RACE、DREAM和QuAIL只用于测试。 RACE和DREAM使用他们的官方测试集. QuAIL使用它的验证和质疑集. 没有被搁置的通道与第二阶段的训练背景完全吻合。 一些RACE段落与CLOTH训练段落共享文本,一些DREAM对话与MuTual训练对话共享文本,因为这些数据集借鉴了类似的考试材料. 移除受影响的问题(RACE有294个,DREAM有349个)会改变每种方法的准确性,改变不到一个点.

A context shared by several questions is counted once for each question. The reconstruction training set contains 1,133,752,208 context tokens, and the task training set contains 58,554,691. The cross-family pairs use the same texts with their own tokenizers.

blocks.en: Constant packet. This control uses the receiver, readers, gates, Stage 1 initialization, data, and training settings of the corresponding LatComm pair: Qwen3.5-4B for the Qwen3.5-0.8B receiver, Qwen3.5-9B for the Gemma-3-1B-pt receiver, and Granite-4.1-8B for the Llama-3.2-1B receiver. The only change is the packet. We encode 2,048 randomly chosen training contexts with the pair’s Stage 1 compressors and average their packets. Every training and test question receives this mean packet, so the packet carries no information about the question’s context.
blocks.zh: 固定的包。 此控件使用接收器,读取器,闸门,第1阶段初始化,数据,以及相应的LatComm配对的训练设置: Quen3.5-4B 为 Quen3.5-0.8B 接收器,Gemma-3-1B-pt接收器为Quen3.5-9B,Llama-3.2-1B接收器为Granite-4.1-8B。 唯一的变化是包。 我们用对子的第一阶段压缩器和平均数据包来编码2 048个随机选择的训练环境。 每个培训和测试问题都会收到这个中间包,

blocks.en: Embedding. This baseline compresses the context into one vector with a frozen text embedding model. We use F2LLM-v2-14B ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and BGE-Multilingual-Gemma2 (9B) ( Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, 2024 ) , each paired with the frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B and Gemma-3-1B-pt receivers. The encoder processes the context as one input, without the question and without chunk pooling. Its last-token representation is L2-normalized, which gives a 5,120-dimensional vector for F2LLM and a 3,584-dimensional vector for BGE. A trainable shared projector maps this vector to one slot. The readers and gates are the same as in LatComm , and they read this slot at every receiver layer: 24 layers for Qwen3.5-0.8B and 26 for Gemma-3-1B-pt. The stored 32-bit vectors take 20 KiB and 14 KiB. Each interface is trained from a fresh initialization on the task data, without a reconstruction stage. F2LLM uses a 32,768-token input limit, which truncates no test context. BGE truncates its input to 8,192 tokens. This affects 93 of the 55,890 test questions, which share five documents. For Table 6 , BGE is paired with the Llama-3.2-1B receiver (16 layers). In this run, the BGE vectors are computed in bfloat16 and stored, instead of in 32-bit precision during training. On 15 documents of different lengths, the two computations give a cosine similarity above 0.999.
blocks.zh: 内嵌. 这个基线将上下文压缩成一个矢量,并带有一个冻结的文本嵌入模型. 我们使用F2LLM-v2-14B (张等,2026年)和BGE-多语种-Gemma2(9B)(北京人工智能学院,2024年),分别与冰冻的Quen3.5-0.8B和Gemma-3-1B-pt接收器对齐. 编码器将上下文处理为一个输入,没有问题和块集合。 它最后的托肯表示是L2-正态化的,它给出了F2LLM的5,120维向量和BGE的3,584维向量. 一个可训练的共享投影仪将这个矢量映射到一个槽中. 阅读器和门与LatComm中相同,他们在每个接收器层阅读这个插槽:Quen3.5-0.8B为24层,Gemma-3-1B-pt为26层. 存储的32位矢量取20KiB和14KiB. 每个接口都从任务数据的新初始化开始训练,没有重建阶段. F2LLM使用32,768个托肯输入限制,该限制可切换无试验上下文. BGE将其输入量缩短为8,192个令牌. 这影响到55 890个测试问题中的93个,这些测试问题共有5份文件。 就表6而言,BGE与Llama-3.2-1B接收器(16层)成对。 在此运行中,BGE向量以bfloat16计算并存储,而不是在训练中以32位精度计算. 在15份长度不同的文档上,两种计算给出了0.999以上的余弦相似度.

blocks.en: xRAG. We adapt xRAG ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) . A frozen SFR-Embedding-Mistral encoder ( Salesforce AI Research, 2024 ) reads the complete context, and a two-layer MLP maps its 4,096-dimensional last-token representation to one soft token placed before the receiver’s prompt. Only the MLP is trained, first on reconstruction and then on the task data. Our adaptation differs from the original in three ways: there is no retrieval or document selection, the receiver is Qwen3.5-0.8B, and task training uses the gold option letter without a distillation term. The second xRAG variant replaces the embedding model with the last-token state of Qwen3.5-4B, which has 2,560 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 克赖格 我们适应xRAG(Cheng等人,2024年). 一个冷冻的SFR-Embedding-Mistral编码器(Salesforce AI Research,2024年)读取了完整的上下文,一个两层的MLP将其4,096维最后托肯的表示映射到一个软符上,放在接收器的提示前. 只有MLP接受过培训,首先是重建,然后是任务数据。 我们的改编在三个方面与原版不同:没有检索或文档选择,接收器是Quen3.5-0.8B,任务训练使用没有蒸馏术语的黄金选项字母. 第二个xRAG变体将嵌入模型替换为最后一个托肯状态的Quen3.5-4B,它有2,560个维度.

blocks.en: Appendix D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 附录D

blocks.en: Packet settings. Table 10 changes the context encoder or one packet setting at a time. The packet settings use the Qwen3.5-4B encoder and change the number of slots (8, 32, 64), the slot width (128, 256, 512), and the number of layer pairs (24, 12, 6). Reconstruction improves with every increase in capacity: a larger encoder, more slots, wider slots, and more layer pairs all lower the Stage 1 loss and raise the token accuracy. The widest slots give the best reconstruction, with 79.0% token accuracy, and the highest Task Avg, 66.88. Task Avg changes less than reconstruction. It stays between 63.84 and 66.88 over all configurations, and every configuration is above the best single-vector baseline (61.98). With 8 slots per pair, the packet takes 96 KiB, one quarter of the default size, and Task Avg is 65.81, against 65.43 for the default packet. With 12 and 6 layer pairs, Task Avg is 64.76 and 63.84. At 96 KiB, a packet with all layer pairs and 8 slots is therefore more accurate than a packet with 6 layer pairs and 32 slots.
blocks.zh: 包装设置 。 表10每次更改上下文编码器或一个包设置. 数据包设置使用Quen3.5-4B编码器,并更改槽数(8,32,64),槽宽(128,256,512)和层对数(24,12,6). 重建随着容量的提高而改善:一个更大的编码器,更多的插槽,更大的插槽,更多的层对都降低了第一阶段的丢失,提高了符号的准确度. 最宽的插槽给予最好的重建,79.0%的符号精确度,最高的Avg,66.88. 任务 Avg的变化小于重建. 它在所有配置中停留在63.84至66.88之间,每个配置都高于最佳的单载体基线(61.98. 每对有8个插槽,包需要96 KiB,是默认大小的四分之一,而Avg任务是65.81,默认包是65.43. 拥有12和6层对,Avg任务为64.76和63.84. 在96 KiB时,一个装有所有层对和8个槽的包比装有6层对和32个槽的包更准确.

blocks.en: Training loss. Figure 5 shows the training loss of both stages for the same configurations. In Stage 1, the loss decreases throughout training, and the configurations keep the order of Table 10 : more capacity gives a lower reconstruction loss. In Stage 2, the curves are close to each other for the three encoders and for the three slot counts, and the loss is lower with wider slots and with more layer pairs.
blocks.zh: 训练损失。 图5显示两个阶段在相同配置方面的培训损失。 在第一阶段,整个培训期间的损失减少,而配置则保持表10的顺序:能力增加,重建损失减少。 在阶段2中,对三个编码器和三个槽计数来说,曲线是相近的,损失率随着更宽的槽和更多的层对而降低.

blocks.en: Packet controls. Table 11 tests whether the receiver uses the content of the packet. The same trained readers and gates reach 65.39 Task Avg with the packet of the question’s own context, 45.59 with the packet of another context, and 39.60 without a packet. The own packet is the most accurate of the three on all 12 task datasets, and the packet of another context lowers the accuracy by 9.8 to 30.1 points. On the held-out datasets, the own packet reaches 49.82 Held-out Avg, against 36.28 with the packet of another context and 36.41 without a packet. A packet from another context therefore gives no gain on new datasets, and the gain comes from the content of the own packet. The Constant packet control, whose readers and gates are trained with one fixed packet, reaches 60.25 Task Avg and 43.37 Held-out Avg.
blocks.zh: 包裹控制器 表11测试接收器是否使用包的内容. 训练有素的读者和大门用问题本身的背景包达到65.39 Task Avg,用另一背景包达到45.59,没有包达到39.60。 在全部12个任务数据集中,自己的数据包是最准确的3个数据包,另一个上下文的数据包将准确度降低9.8至30.1分. 在被搁置的数据集上,自己的数据包达到了49.82 Hold-out Avg,而36.28的数据包是另一个上下文,36.41的数据包没有数据包。 因此,来自另一个上下文的包对新的数据集没有好处,收益来自自己的包的内容。 恒定包控制器的阅读器和门用一个固定包进行训练,达到60.25 Task Avg和43.37 Hold-out Avg。

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录E 补充分析

blocks.en: Seed variation. We repeat Stage 2 of the default pair with three seeds. The three runs share the compressors and the packets. Task Avg is 65.43, 65.72, and 65.88, with a mean of 65.68 and a standard deviation of 0.23. The main tables report the first run, which is the lowest of the three, and the gain over the best baseline (61.98) is much larger than the variation between seeds.
blocks.zh: 种子变异. 我们重复默认对的第二阶段 有三个种子。 三人共用压缩机和包. Avg任务为65.43,65.72,65.88,平均值为65.68,标准偏差为0.23. 主要表格报告第一次运行,是三场运行中最低的,超过最佳基准(61.98)的收益远大于种子间的变化.

blocks.en: Gain source. We split the test questions of the 12 task datasets by whether the Qwen3.5-4B encoder answers them correctly when it reads the full text, which holds for 76% of the questions (Figure 6 ). On these questions, LatComm reaches 72.4% accuracy, against 68.7% for the Embedding baseline and 64.5% for the Constant packet. On the other questions, the three methods are close, with 50.5%, 48.0%, and 50.1%. The gain of LatComm is therefore on the questions that the encoder itself can answer from the context.
blocks.zh: 增益来源. 我们把12个任务数据集的测试问题分为: Qwen3.5-4B编码器在读完全文时是否正确回答它们,而全文占据了76%的问题(图6). 关于这些问题,LatComm达到72.4%的准确度,嵌入基线为68.7%,常数包为64.5%。 在其他问题上,三种方法接近,分别为50.5%、48.0%和50.1%。 因此,LatComm的好处在于编码器本身可以从上下文中回答的问题.

blocks.en: Context length. Figure 7 plots the receiver time per question for each of the 115 QuALITY articles. With text passing, the time grows linearly with the context length, from 265 ms for the shortest article to 707 ms for the longest. With a packet, it stays between 130 and 135 ms for every article, because the receiver always reads the same number of slots.
blocks.zh: 上下文长. 图7列出115个QuALITY文章中每个问题的接收时间。 随着文本的流传,时间随着上下文长度的线性增长,从最短文章的265ms增加到最长文章的707ms. 每篇文章都保留130至135毫秒,因为接收器读数总是相同的。

blocks.en: Gate values. We record the gates of the default pair on a sample of 5,386 test questions (Figure 8 ). The mean gate is 0.40, and it differs across layer pairs, from 0.05 at the last pair to 0.59 at pair 18. The slots of one layer pair also differ: 23.4% of the layer–slot cells have a mean gate below 0.05, and 4.3% have a mean gate above 0.95. The receiver therefore weights the slots differently at each layer pair, which one gate per layer could not express.
blocks.zh: 门值. 我们在5,386个测试问题的样本(图8)上记录了默认对的门. 平均门为0.40门,各层对不同,从最后一对的0.05到18对的0.59不等. 一层对的槽也不同:23.4%的层-槽细胞的中间门低于0.05,4.3%的中间门高于0.95. 因此,接收器在每个层对上对槽进行不同的加权,每层一个门无法表示.

blocks.en: Packet similarity. Figure 9 compares the packets of the contexts in the same sample. The slots of one layer pair are nearly orthogonal at the first layer pairs, with a mean cosine similarity of 0.04, and more similar at the last ones, with 0.65. The packets of two contexts from different datasets have a mean cosine similarity of 0.72, so a part of the packet is shared by all contexts, which agrees with the accuracy of the Constant packet control. The other part separates the contexts. Packets from the same dataset are more similar than packets from different datasets at every layer pair. A nearest-mean classifier on the mean slot of a layer pair, fitted on half of the contexts and tested on the rest, identifies the source dataset among 12 with 30% to 92% balanced accuracy, against 8.3% by chance.
blocks.zh: 包类似. 图9比较了同一样本中的环境包。 一层对子的槽在第一层对子时几乎呈正交状,平均余弦相似度为0.04,而在最后一层则比较相似,为0.65. 来自不同数据集的两种上下文包的中位素相似度为0.72,因此包的一部分被所有上下文共享,这与常数包控件的准确性一致. 另一部分将背景分开。 同一个数据集的包比每个层对的不同数据集的包更相似. 层对平均档次上的一个最接近的平均值分类器,安装在一半的上下文上,并在其余部分上进行测试,它以30%到92%的平衡精确度确定12个源数据集,而偶然确定为8.3%。
